name: Spooky Friends Dress Up
source:
“It’s Halloween! You love this day because you always celebrate with your friends! Dress them up and strengthen your friendship with them. They will eventually come to love you...

[From [url=https://daijubudef.itch.io/spooky-friends-dress-up]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
「萬聖節到啦！你最喜歡這一天，因為每年你都會和朋友們一起慶祝！幫他們打扮一番，增進你們之間的友誼。他們終有一天會愛上你……」

［摘自[url=https://daijubudef.itch.io/spooky-friends-dress-up]Itch.io[/url]］
